description: Wave 1 of the 2026-08-18 parent-orchestrator run: doc reconciliation + the D0.7 linkage triage. Every unit is pure Read/Grep/Glob + reasoning. No writes, no builds, no MCP. Each unit returns a compact brief as text.

units.prompt: READ-ONLY. Reconcile re/analysis/RE_MASTER_PLAN_2026-07.md against the CURRENT ROADMAP.md (v3, 2026-08-15). The master plan was last rebuilt 2026-07-31 and is stale: line 3 still calls itself a companion to ROADMAP v2 phases R0-R8, and line 10 claims 'Active phase R7 (R0-R6 closed)', which ROADMAP.md:101-104 explicitly repudiates. Read BOTH files in full, plus the newest ~40 entries of re/analysis/CHANGELOG.md (newest first, below the <!-- ENTRIES --> marker). Produce: (1) A defect list: every claim in the master plan that the current roadmap or changelog contradicts, each with master-plan line number, the contradicting citation, and a one-line correction. (2) A verdict on each item in its section 7 next-sessions queue (lines ~149-167): SURVIVES / OVERTAKEN-BY-EVENTS / NEEDS-REPHRASING, with evidence. Its item 1 'librw sizing session' is known overtaken. (3) A verdict on milestones M1-M4 (lines ~59-87): which still hold. (4) A PROPOSED REPLACEMENT for the file's header block (lines 1-15) and its section 7, written out in full as text, in the file's own style and formatting, ready to paste. Do NOT write any file. Cite line numbers throughout. NO-GUESSING: if the evidence does not settle something, mark it [UNCERTAIN] and say exactly what is missing.

READ-ONLY. Reconcile the D1 section of ROADMAP.md (lines 213-261) against evidence that postdates it. The section was written 2026-08-15 and says the librw inversion is BLOCKED on divergences of 71.61 percent (01_inrace_track), 69.15 (round3_result), 68.94 (round2_result), 21.69 (01_action), and argues 'the divergence accumulates', i.e. leaked or unreset state. Read: ROADMAP.md in full; the newest ~40 entries of re/analysis/CHANGELOG.md; and every RESULT.md / MEASUREMENT.md under verify/d1_* and verify/librw_ref (glob for them). Note that .happy/project-info.json (2026-08-17) reports the same A/B at 16/16 max 1.01 percent after a mirror fix. Produce: (1) A chronological evidence chain for the D1 diagnosis, showing each claim, its retraction if any, and what currently stands. There were at least three successive wrong diagnoses; name them in order. (2) A verdict: is the ROADMAP's stated D1 blocker still real, superseded, or unproven? State exactly which artifact settles it. (3) The two internal contradictions in ROADMAP.md: the env-var count (128 at line 58 vs 138 at lines 156-159) and the linkage figures at lines 151-155 which the D0.7 entry corrected the same day. For each, say which number is right and cite the source. (4) A PROPOSED REPLACEMENT for lines 213-261 written out in full as text, in the file's own style, ready to paste. Do NOT write any file. Cite line numbers. NO-GUESSING: mark [UNCERTAIN] rather than inferring.

READ-ONLY. Find corrections that were committed but never recorded in the tracker audit trail. FIRST read the header of re/analysis/CHANGELOG.md (lines 1-30) so you apply its own scope rule: it records WHY TRACKER STATE CHANGED - confidence moves, deferrals upheld or overturned, uncertainties filed or resolved, and CORRECTIONS TO PREVIOUS CLAIMS. It is explicitly NOT a commit log, so do NOT report missing entries merely because a commit has no matching line. Then read the newest ~40 CHANGELOG entries and, using git log and git show (read-only git is permitted), examine every commit from 2026-08-14 to HEAD. For each commit, decide: does it contain a claim correction, a decision reversal, a confidence move, or an uncertainty resolution that has NO corresponding CHANGELOG entry? The known case is c16eb4cc, which reverted decision D-S3-4 and corrected earlier claims about handedness and the FX bloom. Produce: (1) A table of commits, with verdict ENTRY-EXISTS / ENTRY-MISSING / OUT-OF-SCOPE and a one-line reason. (2) For every ENTRY-MISSING, a DRAFTED CHANGELOG entry written in the file's exact format: one single line starting 'YYYY-MM-DD  ' then subject, then an all-caps headline clause naming the correction, then the mechanical detail with file:line and RVA citations, ending with the tracker-state note. Match the density and voice of the existing entries. (3) A note on whether any commit moved hooks.csv without a CHANGELOG entry, which would be a harder defect. Do NOT write any file. NO-GUESSING: if you cannot establish what a commit corrected, say so rather than inventing a narrative.

READ-ONLY. This is the ROADMAP D0.7 triage, part 1 of 2. CONTEXT: mashedmod/build.bat links only 198 of 433 .cpp under mashedmod/src/mashed_re/ into the mashed_re.exe target; the rest reach only the dev .asi via mashedmod/asi_sources.rsp. build.bat lines 90-113 explain why: a full-source-set exe crashed at startup with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) because many reimplementations have STATIC INITIALIZERS that dereference MASHED.exe RVAs, which do not exist in the standalone. Files are meant to be added back one at a time as their RVA references are neutralized. YOUR SCOPE: every .cpp under these four directories, which are 0 percent or near-0 percent linked - Save/ (17 files), Gameplay/ (7), Input/ (4), Particle/ (3). Read build.bat and asi_sources.rsp first to confirm which of these are genuinely absent from the exe list. Then READ EACH .cpp and classify it: (A) UNLINKED-BY-INTENT - it is .asi harness code, e.g. its whole body is hook installation against the live original, or it is a self-test; (B) SAFE-TO-ADD - no file-scope construct that touches a MASHED.exe address at load time; (C) BLOCKED-STATIC-INIT - it has one, and you must NAME the exact construct and line. Things that make a file class C: any namespace-scope or file-scope object with a non-trivial constructor that reads or writes an absolute address in the 0x00400000-0x00b60000 range; a file-scope RH_ScopedInstall or hook-registration object; a global reference bound to a MASHED.exe RVA at load time; a static array initialized from such a pointer. A function-local static is NOT class C unless the function runs at load time. Also flag any file whose body calls call_original_0x... since that cannot work in the standalone. Produce a table: file | class A/B/C | C4 rows in hooks.csv whose file column names it | C3 rows | the blocking construct with line number if class C | one-clause justification. Then an ORDERED ADD-BACK LIST of the class-B files, ranked by C4 rows unlocked descending, ties broken by fewest external dependencies. Finish with counts per class. Do NOT write any file. Cite file:line for every class-C verdict. NO-GUESSING: if you cannot tell whether a construct runs at load time, mark it [UNCERTAIN] and classify it C, since the cost of a wrong B is a boot crash.

READ-ONLY. This is the ROADMAP D0.7 triage, part 2 of 2. CONTEXT: mashedmod/build.bat links only 198 of 433 .cpp under mashedmod/src/mashed_re/ into the mashed_re.exe target; the rest reach only the dev .asi via mashedmod/asi_sources.rsp. build.bat lines 90-113 explain why: a full-source-set exe crashed at startup with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) because many reimplementations have STATIC INITIALIZERS that dereference MASHED.exe RVAs, which do not exist in the standalone. YOUR SCOPE: the unlinked .cpp under Util/ (72 of 84 unlinked) and Audio/ (21 of 25 unlinked). Read build.bat and asi_sources.rsp first to determine exactly which files in those two directories are absent from the exe source list. Because this is a large set, work by SAMPLING TO A PATTERN rather than reading all 93 in full: many Util/ files are named PromoLoop_round<N>.cpp or similar batch-promotion buckets and are likely structurally identical, so read enough of them to establish the shared shape, verify the shape holds by grepping the rest, and classify the family as a unit while naming any file that deviates. Classify each file: (A) UNLINKED-BY-INTENT - .asi harness code or a self-test; (B) SAFE-TO-ADD - no file-scope construct touching a MASHED.exe address at load time; (C) BLOCKED-STATIC-INIT - names the exact construct and line. Class C triggers: any namespace-scope or file-scope object with a non-trivial constructor reading or writing an absolute address in 0x00400000-0x00b60000; a file-scope RH_ScopedInstall or hook-registration object; a global bound to a MASHED.exe RVA at load time. Also flag any file calling call_original_0x... since that cannot work in the standalone. Produce: (1) A family table for the repeated Util/ shapes: family name | member count | class | shared blocking construct if any | the deviating members. (2) A per-file table for everything that is not part of a family, same columns as the family table plus C4 and C3 row counts from hooks.csv. (3) An ORDERED ADD-BACK LIST of class-B files ranked by C4 rows unlocked descending. (4) A specific verdict on Audio/: it holds 585 hooks.csv rows and 78 C3-plus-C4 rows in unlinked files, so state whether Audio/ is unlinked by intent (it wraps DirectShow and RenderWare audio that the standalone may not initialize) or by drift. Finish with counts per class. Do NOT write any file. Cite file:line for every class-C verdict. NO-GUESSING: mark [UNCERTAIN] and classify C when unsure, since a wrong B costs a boot crash.
